rules.title: 📖 How to Play
rules.kd.intro: A social deduction game. One player is secretly the Killer. Can the village find them before it’s too late?
rules.kd.killerDesc: Each night, secretly eliminate one player. Avoid suspicion during the day. Win by reducing players to 2.
rules.kd.doctorDesc: Each night, secretly protect one player (including yourself). If you save the Killer’s target, nobody dies. 1 Doctor per 5 players.
rules.kd.villagerDesc: You have no special power — but your vote counts. Debate, accuse, and eliminate the Killer to win.
rules.kd.step1: Roles assigned — Each player receives a secret role. Do not reveal it!
rules.kd.step2: Night falls — The Killer picks a victim. The Doctor picks someone to protect. Both choose in secret.
rules.kd.step3: Dawn — The result is announced: either a player was found dead, or the Doctor saved them.
rules.kd.step4: Day discussion — All living players debate and accuse. The dead can only watch.
rules.kd.step5: Vote — Everyone votes to eliminate a suspect. Most votes wins. Ties mean no elimination.
rules.kd.step6: Reveal — The eliminated player’s role is revealed to all. Then night falls again.
rules.kd.win1: Villagers win when the Killer is voted out.
rules.kd.win2: Killer wins when only 2 players remain alive (a tied vote means the Killer kills again).
rules.kd.tip: 💡 Tip: Use the Hide Role button if others might see your screen.
rules.ttt.intro: The classic game of Xs and Os — now with score tracking and match formats.
rules.ttt.objective: Get three of your symbols in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — before your opponent does.
rules.ttt.step1: Two players are randomly assigned ✕ (X) and ○ (O). Others watch as spectators.
rules.ttt.step2: X always goes first. Take turns clicking empty cells on the 3×3 grid.
rules.ttt.step3: The first to place three in a row wins the game. Symbols swap for the next game.
rules.ttt.step4: If all 9 cells fill up with no winner, it’s a draw.
rules.ttt.format1: Free Play — play unlimited games, track score indefinitely.
rules.ttt.format2: Best of 3 / 5 / 7 — first to win the majority claims the match.
rules.ttt.tip: 💡 Tip: The room host sets the match format in Settings before the game starts.
rules.scb.intro: One player draws a secret word while everyone else races to guess it. The faster you guess, the more points you earn.
rules.scb.step1: Each round, one player becomes the Drawer. They’re shown 3 secret words and must choose one.
rules.scb.step2: Everyone else sees only _ _ _ _ _ (blanks) and must type their guess in the chat.
rules.scb.step3: Correct guesses earn points based on how quickly you answered. Hints appear after 30s and 55s.
rules.scb.step4: The Drawer earns points for each player who guesses correctly. Draw clearly!
rules.scb.step5: The round ends when time runs out or everyone has guessed. Roles rotate — everyone gets a turn to draw.
rules.scb.step6: After all rounds, the highest scorer wins the game.
rules.scb.tool1: Pencil — free-draw. Adjust color and brush size.
rules.scb.tool3: Fill — flood-fill an area with your chosen color.
rules.scb.tool4: Clear — wipe the canvas and start over.
rules.scb.tip: 💡 Tip: Once you guess correctly you can’t chat — don’t spoil it for others!
rules.uno.intro: Classic card-matching game. Be the first to empty your hand and shout UNO when you’re down to one card!
rules.uno.numbersDesc: Play on a matching color or matching number.
rules.uno.actionDesc:
Skip — next player loses turn.
Reverse — reverses play order (2-player: acts as Skip).
+2 — next player draws 2 and loses turn.
rules.uno.wildDesc:
Wild — change to any color.
Wild +4 — change color AND next player draws 4 and loses turn.
rules.uno.step1: Each player is dealt 7 cards. The top card of the deck is flipped to start the discard pile.
rules.uno.step2: On your turn, play a card that matches the color or value of the top card. Wild cards can always be played.
rules.uno.step3: Can’t play? Draw one card from the deck. If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately or pass.
rules.uno.step4: When you play down to 1 card, the game automatically shouts UNO for you!
rules.uno.step5: First player to play all their cards wins the game.
rules.uno.win: Play all your cards to win. Other players’ remaining cards don’t score — it’s a pure race.
rules.uno.tip: 💡 Tip: Wild +4 can only be played if you have no other matching card — but this isn’t enforced digitally.
rules.quiz.intro: A 15-question trivia challenge pulled fresh from the internet. Answer fast — speed earns extra points!
rules.quiz.step1: The game fetches 5 Easy, 5 Medium, and 5 Hard questions at random from a public trivia database.
rules.quiz.step2: Each question shows 4 options. Tap your answer before the 20-second timer runs out.
rules.quiz.step3: Correct answers score 500–1000 points based on speed. Wrong or no answer scores 0.
rules.quiz.step4: After each question, the correct answer is revealed alongside the updated leaderboard.
rules.quiz.step5: The player with the highest total score after all 15 questions wins.
rules.quiz.win: Highest score after 15 questions wins. Ties go to whoever was consistently faster across all correct answers.
rules.quiz.tip: 💡 Tip: Questions are randomised from thousands of categories — expect anything from science to pop culture!
